description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 002 are a square-grid clay design for a terracotta jali garden wall, shown in the product photo as the backdrop to an outdoor dining area, where the open pattern gives privacy without closing the garden in.

## How it looks
The photo shows a regular square grid built up into a full garden wall. In daylight the openings break the wall into a light, airy texture, and the warm clay colour tends to suit planting, timber furniture and brick paving. In the evening, lights behind the screen can throw a soft grid of shadows across the seating.

## Where it works
- **Jali wall for outdoor dining area** or a barbecue corner, as a backdrop that still lets the breeze through.
- **Clay jali garden screen** to hide a utility area, water tank or neighbour's view.
- **Square jali garden boundary** along a lawn or terrace edge.

A solid wall can trap heat and feel heavy in a small garden; an open clay screen tends to keep air moving and looks lighter. Terracotta usually weathers to a natural patina outdoors instead of peeling like paint.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: square grid (from a garden wall photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you plan quantities and pillars.

A tall free-standing garden screen generally needs brick or RCC pillars at intervals and a firm footing, so ask your mason or contractor for the support detail. Rinse with water and a soft brush; avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall length and height for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a terracotta jali garden wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is terracotta jali good for an outdoor garden wall?
faqs.a: It is a common choice. Fired clay tends to handle sun and rain well and weathers naturally, and the open pattern keeps air moving. A tall screen needs pillars and a proper footing, so plan the support with your mason.

faqs.q: Jali wall or solid boundary wall: which suits a garden?
faqs.a: A solid wall gives full privacy and security; a jali wall gives partial privacy with airflow and filtered light. Many homes use a solid lower section with a jali panel above.
